description: Source code for managing Device Update (DU) state changes in a TR-069 management context, including handling DU state change completion notifications and initiating DU state change requests.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoChangeDUState
methods.description: Initiates a device update (DU) state change operation by constructing a message with operation details and calling the changeDUState service.

methods.name: handle_dustatechangecomplete
methods.description: Handles the completion of a DU state change, retrieves the command key and results, and sends a DU state change complete message.

methods.name: handle_dustatechangecomplete_cb
methods.description: Callback wrapper for handling DU state change completion.

methods.name: differ_dustatechangecomplete_handling
methods.description: Schedules handling of a DU state change completion event.

methods.name: dustatechangecomplete_notification
methods.description: Notification handler for DU state change completion events, triggers handling when status is 'Done'.

methods.name: DM_AmxChangeDUState_init
methods.description: Initializes the DU state change handling, subscribes to relevant notifications, and processes any pending completion events.

methods.name: DM_AmxChangeDUState_clean
methods.description: Cleans up the DU state change handling by unsubscribing from notifications.
